claim.claim-text: 1. A system (10) for operating an autonomous vehicle, said system (10) comprising:

a passenger-detector (18) operable to determine a passenger-count (20) of passengers (22) present in a host-vehicle (12); a controller-circuit (32) in communication with the passenger-detector (18) and vehicle-controls (26) of the host-vehicle (12), said controller-circuit (32) configured to operate the host-vehicle (12) in an autonomous-mode (14) and in accordance with a parameter (40), wherein the parameter (40) is set to an empty-value (46) when passenger-count (20) is equal to zero, and the parameter (40) is set to an occupied-value (48) different from the empty-value (46) when the passenger (22) count is greater than zero, wherein the parameter (40) is an acceleration-rate (42) of the host-vehicle (12).
2. The system (10) in accordance with claim 1, wherein the empty-value (46) is greater than the occupied-value (48).

3. The system (10) in accordance with any of the preceding claims, wherein the parameter (40) further includes a cornering-speed (44) of the host-vehicle (12), and the empty-value (46) is greater than the occupied-value (48).

4. The system (10) in accordance with any of the preceding claims, wherein the host-vehicle (12) is configured so a passenger (22) can sit or stand while the host-vehicle (12) is moving, the passenger-detector (18) is operable to determine that the passenger (22) is sitting or standing, and the controller-circuit (32) is configured to set the parameter (40) to a first value (50) in response to a determination that all passengers (22) are sitting, and a second-value (52) different from the first-value (50) in response to a determination that at least one passenger (22) is standing.

5. The system (10) in accordance with claim 4, wherein the passenger-detector (18) is operable to determine when the at least one passenger (22) is standing and is not gripping a hand-hold (54), and the parameter (40) is set to a third-value (58) different from the first-value (50) and the second-value (52) in response to a determination that the at least one passenger (22) is standing and is not gripping a hand-hold (54).

6. The system (10) in accordance with any of the preceding claims, wherein the controller-circuit (32) is configured to estimate a braking-distance (56) of the host-vehicle (12) in accordance with the passenger-count (20).
7. The system in accordance with any one of the preceding claims, wherein the controller-circuit (32) comprises:
8. A method (100) for operating an autonomous vehicle, said method (100) comprising:

9. The method (100) in accordance with claim 8, wherein the method (100) includes setting (120) the parameter (40) used for operating the host-vehicle (12) in an autonomous-mode (14) to the occupied-value (48) in response to a determination that the passenger (22) count is greater than zero.
10. The method (100) in accordance with any one of claims 8 or 9, wherein the empty-value (46) is greater than the occupied-value (48).

11. The method (100) in accordance with any one of claims 8 to 10, wherein the parameter (40) further includes a cornering-speed (44) of the host-vehicle (12), and the empty-value (46) is greater than the occupied-value (48).

12. The method (100) in accordance with any one of claims 8 to 11, wherein the host-vehicle (12) is configured so a passenger (22) can sit or stand while the host-vehicle (12) is moving, said method (100) includes

determining (130), using the passenger-detector (18), that the passenger (22) is sitting; and setting (135) the parameter (40) to a first value (50) in response to a determination that all passengers (22) are sitting, and setting (140) the parameter (40) to a second-value (52) different from the first-value (50) in response to a determination that at least one passenger (22) is standing.
13. The method (100) in accordance with claim 12, wherein method (100) includes

determining (130) that at least one passenger (22) is standing and is not gripping a hand-hold (54); and setting (150) the parameter (40) to a third-value (58) different from the first-value (50) and the second-value (52) in response to a determination that the at least one passenger (22) is standing and is not gripping a hand-hold (54).

14. The method (100) in accordance with any one of claims 8 to 13, wherein method (100) includes estimating (155) a braking-distance (56) of the host-vehicle (12) in accordance with the passenger-count (20).

15. A non-transitory computer-readable storage-medium (36) comprising one or more programs (105-160) for execution by one or more processors (34) of a first device (32), the one or more programs (105-160) including instructions which, when executed by the one or more processors (34), cause the first device (32) to perform the method (100) of any one of claims 8 to 14.
